source_title: Pixel 11 hits record-low price with $200 discount
source_excerpt:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
Great phone cameras and clean Android software matter most when you want a handset that just feels good to use every day. The Google Pixel 11 fits that kind of buyer well, and there’s a strong deal on Amazon right now that makes it a lot more tempting.
The Pixel 11 is down to $699 on Amazon, which is $200 off its $899 recommended retail price. That’s a 22% discount relative to the RRP. It’s also the lowest price we’ve seen this year, and with this being by far the lowest price since launch, it’s a standout chance to grab Google’s latest standard flagship for less.
Google only recently launched the Pixel 11 in late August 2026, so this price drop feels especially notable. The phone packs a 6.3-inch display with a smooth 60-120Hz refresh rate and a bright panel, all in a compact flagship-style design. It runs on Google’s Tensor G6 chip with 12GB of RAM, and AI features remain a big part of the experience.
Cameras are still one of the main reasons to buy a Pixel, and the Pixel 11 keeps that going with strong photo quality. Battery life is also solid enough for a full day or better, depending on how you use it. Put that together with Google’s polished software, and you’ve got a phone that covers the basics people care about most without overcomplicating things.
It also carries a 4.4-star Amazon rating, which adds some extra confidence if you’ve been waiting for a price drop before making your move.
